text: Hello everyone, today we are discussing the progress of our meeting AI project.
Our main goal is to create a system that can automatically transcribe
meaning recordings and generate useful insights.
I have completed the initial front end design, the upload pages ready and the users can select
an audio file from the computer.
I will work on the AI pipeline.
Next, I will integrate faster visible to convert the meeting audio into a time spent transcript.
I will work on the backend API.
The fast API server will receive the uploaded audio file and send it to the AI pipeline.
We should try to complete this task by Friday.
After that, we can connect the front end backend and AI pipeline and test the complete system.
I agree, we should also prepare a short recording for a September evaluation.
